name: Katze Valentine
source: Police. Kittiara's twin sister. When she was young, she had an accident that left much of her body in disrepair. Thanks to her older sister, Paika, she was rebuilt as a cyborg. She herself chose to have a strong and powerful physique so that she could fight crime. She has a wacky sense of humor and no shame at all. She is currently in a romantic relationship with Karla Ignitio.
